example.title: St. Charles Hospital, 400 East New York Street

brief: Six-storey Art Deco Catholic hospital of 1932: buff brick with stepped vertical piers, a taller central tower block over the main entrance, flat roofs, and lower wings running back from the front. Parking lot and a lawn with a statue by the entrance; the emergency entrance is on the side street.
